items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken: We love Fig Newtons. ... Ken: We collected Crispy Cream for the museum. ... [to Ken: There’s the fox. He’s checking out your ride.]

ctx.x: …I don’t mind if in perpetuity, if people see me eating a Fig Newton, man. It’s cool. Because it’s Smithsonian, it’s cool. Ken: We love Fig Newtons.
You know what I’m saying, you know? If our technology and shit is around a hundred and fifty years from now they will be going, “What is that thing he’s eating?” This is a Fig Newton. Yum. Very good.
